<DESCRIPTION>SALES RELEASE AND CHARTS DATED JUNE 1, 2011
<TEXT>
<HTML><HEAD>
<TITLE>Sales Release and Charts Dated June 1, 2011</TITLE>
</HEAD>
 <BODY BGCOLOR="WHITE">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="right"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Exhibit 99.1 </B></FONT></P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px">

<IMG SRC="g194731ex99_1pg9new.jpg" ALT="LOGO"> </P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">For Release: 10:45 a.m. EST </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">June 1, 2011 </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><I>May U.S. Retail Sales Rise 9 Percent on Demand
</I></B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><I>for Fuel-Efficient Vehicles </I></B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>&#149;</B></FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Chevrolet Cruze retail sales surge 150 percent </B></FONT></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>&#149;</B></FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Combined GMC Terrain, Chevrolet Equinox retail sales rise 58 percent </B></FONT></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>&#149;</B></FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Buick and GMC retail sales rise for 20<FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP
STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">th</SUP></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> successive month </FONT></B></FONT></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR>
<TD WIDTH="3%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>&#149;</B></FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Cadillac retail sales up
16<FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">th</SUP></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> month in a row; Chevrolet&#146;s up for 9</FONT><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">th</SUP></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> consecutive month </FONT></B></FONT></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>DETROIT &#150;</B> General Motors dealers in the United States reported 221,192 total sales in May, including a 9 percent increase in retail sales
compared to May 2010. Retail sales for GM&#146;s brands were again propelled by the company&#146;s lineup of fuel-efficient passenger cars and crossovers. Total sales declined 1 percent on lower fleet volume. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">For the month, Chevrolet Cruze had its best retail sales since its launch as Chevrolet dealers reported 18,996 retail deliveries. The GMC Terrain and
Chevrolet Equinox, GM&#146;s compact crossovers, saw a combined retail sales increase of 58 percent during the month. Passenger car and crossover retail sales also rose substantially, up 32 percent and 17 percent, respectively. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;Customers continue to demand better fuel economy and our commitment to produce high-quality, fuel-efficient vehicles is paying off,&#148; said Don
Johnson, vice president, U.S. Sales Operations. &#147;We expect that fuel prices will continue to be volatile and we&#146;re prepared to continue meeting the needs of an ever-changing market.&#148; </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px;padding-bottom:0px;"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Compared to last year, May fleet sales were 16 percent lower as rental volumes declined 21 percent. Deliveries to commercial accounts
rose 19 percent &#150; the 14</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">th</SUP></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> consecutive month of
commercial sales gains. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><I>GM&#146;s Newest Vehicles Retail Sales Increase 65 Percent in May </I></B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Combined retail sales for vehicles launched since June 2009 &#150; Chevrolet Equinox, Silverado HD, Cruze, Camaro Convertible and Volt; Buick LaCrosse and
Regal; GMC Sierra HD and Terrain; and Cadillac SRX, CTS Wagon and CTS Coupe &#150; jumped 65 percent during May and are up 74 percent for 2011. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><I>Passenger Cars </I></B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">During the month,
total sales of GM passenger cars increased 13 percent. Retail sales of passenger cars rose 32 percent on the continuing strength of the Cruze, which was up 150 percent compared to the Chevrolet Cobalt it replaced. Also contributing to the gain were
solid retail sales for the Buick Regal and an increase of 28 percent in retail sales for the Cadillac CTS. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;The Cruze, Regal and CTS
Coupe are attracting new customers to GM,&#148; Johnson said. &#147;These vehicles are a strong reason why we&#146;re gaining share in key states like California, New York and Florida so far this year.&#148; </FONT></P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><I>Crossovers </I></B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Total crossover sales declined 1 percent, while retail sales were up 17 percent compared to last year&#146;s May. GM&#146;s crossover retail sales were the highest ever for the month of May and were
driven by a 58-percent increase in combined retail sales for the 32 mile-per-gallon highway rated Equinox and Terrain. Both of GM&#146;s compact crossovers set retail sales records for the month with Equinox retail sales up 62 percent and
Terrain&#146;s 48 percent higher than May 2010. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;Customers love the 610 mile range that our compact crossovers provide and they get it
without sacrificing capability or style,&#148; Johnson said. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">For the year-to-date, retail sales of GM&#146;s crossovers were up 27 percent.
</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><I>Pickups </I></B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Total
combined sales of Chevrolet Silverado and Avalanche, and GMC Sierra decreased 14 percent; with retail sales down 17 percent versus a year ago. For the year-to-date, retail sales for GM&#146;s full-size pickups are up 15 percent, while total sales of
212,478 units represent a 13-percent increase compared to the first five months of 2010. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Month-end dealer inventory in the United States
stood at about 584,000 units, up about 7,000 units compared to April and about 177,000 higher than May 2010. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Brand Key Facts:
</B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">For Release June&nbsp;1, 2011, 10:45 a.m. EDT </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Four-Cylinder Engines Power Chevrolet to Retail Gains </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><I>More than half
of brand&#146;s May sales are fuel-efficient models </I></B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>DETROIT &#150;</B> Chevrolet retail sales increased for the ninth-consecutive
month in May, as retail sales climbed 9 percent compared to the same month a year ago. In addition, more than half of Chevy retail sales in May were four-cylinder models &#150; double the rate five years ago &#150; driven by consumer demand for
Cruze, Malibu, and Equinox. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">For the first five months of 2011, Chevrolet retail sales are up 28 percent over 2010. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;Our retail sales gains, and shift to four-cylinder models, show that Chevrolet is successfully meeting consumers&#146; demands for fuel-efficient
transportation,&#148; said Alan Batey, U.S. vice president, Chevrolet Sales and Service. &#147;We think Chevy&#146;s combination of economy, performance, and style will continue to resonate with today&#146;s customers &#150; no matter what the price
of gas.&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Cruze compact sedan recorded its best retail sales month ever, up 150 percent in May over Chevrolet Cobalt sales a year
ago. In May, 15 percent of retail sales were the Cruze Eco model, which delivers 42 mpg highway with the Ecotec 1.4L engine and manual transmission. For 2011 calendar year to date, Cruze sales have increased nearly threefold over the Cobalt.
</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Retail sales for the Chevrolet Equinox crossover, which delivers up to 32 mpg highway with the Ecotec 2.4L engine, climbed 62 percent in May.
Equinox retail sales are up 52 percent gain for the 2011 calendar year to date. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Retail sales for the Chevrolet Malibu midsize sedan, which
delivers 33 mpg highway with the Ecotec 2.4L engine, climbed 3 percent in May. Year to date, Malibu sales are 4 percent higher than in 2010, which was the best retail sales year for Malibu since 2000. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Founded in Detroit in 1911, Chevrolet celebrates its centennial as a global automotive brand with annual sales of about 4.25&nbsp;million vehicles in
more than 120 countries. Chevrolet provides consumers with fuel-efficient, safe and reliable vehicles that deliver high quality, expressive design, spirited performance and value. The Chevrolet portfolio includes iconic performance cars such as
Corvette and Camaro; dependable, long-lasting pickups and SUVs such as Silverado and Suburban; and award-winning passenger cars and crossovers such as Spark, Cruze, Malibu, Equinox and Traverse. Chevrolet also offers &#147;gas-friendly to
gas-free&#148; solutions including Cruze Eco and Volt. Cruze Eco offers 42 mpg highway while Volt offers 35 miles of electric, gasoline-free driving and an additional 344 miles of extended range. Most new Chevrolet models offer OnStar safety,
security and convenience technologies including OnStar Hands-Free Calling, Automatic Crash Response and Stolen Vehicle Slowdown. More information regarding Chevrolet models can be found at <U>www.chevrolet.com</U>. </FONT></P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px;padding-bottom:0px;" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Buick Achieves 20<FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP
STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">th</SUP></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> Straight Month of Retail Sales Gains </FONT></B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><I>Demand for fuel-efficient luxury cars and crossovers drives brand&#146;s momentum in May </I></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px;padding-bottom:0px;"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>DETROIT &#150;</B> <U>Buick</U> achieved its 20</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP
STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">th</SUP></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> consecutive month of retail sales gains in May, growing 18 percent year over year with total sales up 24 percent. The
brand&#146;s retail sales also have increased 39 percent and its total sales are up 38 percent for the first five months of the year, with significant gains in Miami, New York and Atlanta. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;Increasing demand for <U>fuel-efficient luxury cars and crossovers</U> has made Buick the fastest-growing major automotive brand in the United States,&#148; said Brian Sweeney, U.S. vice president
of Buick&nbsp;&amp; GMC Sales and Service. &#147;We expect Buick&#146;s momentum to continue as we bring more new models to our showrooms throughout the year.&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The fuel-efficient LaCrosse with eAssist arrives this summer and the all-new Verano luxury compact goes into production this fall. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Among the key factors in Buick&#146;s sales success is the <U>Regal</U> <U>sport sedan</U>, which went on sale last May. MSNBC recently ranked Regal among its 10 most-improved vehicles of 2011, praising
&#147;the sleek, racy new Regal&#148; as looking &#147;like nothing that would have graced a Buick showroom just a few years ago.&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Regal
commands one of the highest conquest rates among Buick vehicles, with 46 percent of buyers coming from a non-GM brand and 22 percent of those customers trading in imports, which has helped Buick gain share in key markets like New York and Florida.
</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Fueling interest in the sport sedan is the increased availability of the all-new Regal Turbo, which accounted for a third of Regal&#146;s
retail sales in May. The turbo&#146;s 2.0-liter direct-injection four-cylinder engine delivers better horsepower and torque than the Acura TSX, and with its manual six-speed transmission, it also delivers better fuel economy, with an EPA-rated 32
mpg highway. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;Regal Turbo is an all-around sharp-looking car,&#148; said Jason Duran of Atlanta, who recently purchased one. The
39-year-old vice president and general manager of the Alpharetta Family Skate Center said he fell in love with Regal Turbo when the Carl Black Buick dealership displayed the car at the sports and fitness facility. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;I&#146;d considered BMW and Infiniti, but Regal Turbo really impressed me,&#148; Duran added. &#147;I love the sleek look. It accelerates and
handles like a sports car, and it&#146;s very comfortable and roomy. It was an easy decision to make.&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Regal lineup will grow in the
second half of the year with the introduction of the performance oriented <U>2012 Regal GS</U> and fuel efficient <U>2012 Regal eAssist&#153;</U>. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The eAssist &#147;light electrification&#148; system coming to Regal later this year will debut on the <U>LaCrosse full-size sedan</U> this summer. The <U>2012 LaCrosse with eAssist</U> is expected to
deliver class-leading highway fuel economy of 37 mpg. </FONT></P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><U>Fuel-efficient crossovers</U> also are in demand, with retail sales of <U>Enclave</U> up 14 percent and total sales up
11 percent, calendar year to date. One reason for the Enclave&#146;s sales success is its fuel economy, 24 mpg highway (2WD), which is better than any eight-passenger crossover, including Acura MDX. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Enclave, a four-time winner of Consumer Digest&#146;s Best Buy award, has the highest conquest sales rate of any Buick, with 49 percent coming from
non-GM brands. Approximately 41 percent of all Buick buyers come from non-GM brands and 18 percent come from imports. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>About Buick
</B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><U>Buick</U> is a modern luxury brand offering vehicles with sculpted designs, luxurious interiors with thoughtful personal technologies,
along with responsive-yet-efficient performance. Buick is the fastest growing major&nbsp;automotive brand in the U.S. and&nbsp;is attracting new customers with its portfolio of award-winning models, including the <U>Enclave crossover</U>,
<U>LaCrosse sedan</U>, <U>Regal sport sedan</U> and highly anticipated&nbsp;all-new <U>2012 Buick Verano compact luxury sedan</U>. Learn more about Buick cars and crossovers at <U>www.buick.com</U>, on Twitter <U>@buick</U> or at
<U>www.facebook.com/buick</U>. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"># # # </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT

 <P STYLE="margin-top:24px;margin-bottom:0px;padding-bottom:0px;" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>GMC Delivers 20<FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP
STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">th</SUP></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> Straight Month of Retail Sales Gains </FONT></B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><I>Demand for fuel-efficient vehicles attracts new customers to Terrain, Acadia, and Sierra in May </I></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px;padding-bottom:0px;"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>DETROIT &#150;</B> <U>GMC</U> delivered its 20</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP

and <U>SUVs</U>, with retail sales are up 5 percent year over year and total sales are up 8 percent. In addition, the brand&#146;s retail and total sales are both up 25 percent calendar year to date, with significant gains in New York, Boston and
Phoenix. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;While we&#146;re best known for our professional grade <U>Sierra pickup trucks</U>, more people are discovering how our SUVs
and crossovers deliver both utility and fuel efficiency,&#148; said Brian Sweeney, U.S. vice president of Buick&nbsp;&amp; GMC Sales and Service. &#147;As a result, <U>Terrain</U> and <U>Acadia</U> have accounted for 49 percent of the brand&#146;s
retail sales for two months running.&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">In May, Terrain achieved a 48-percent increase in retail sales and a 42-percent increase in total
sales, year over year. The <U>smaller SUV</U> delivers a segment-leading EPA-rated 32 mpg in highway driving. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Acadia retail and total sales
rose 19 percent in May. Acadia offers the best highway fuel economy, 24 mpg highway (2WD), of any eight-passenger crossover SUV, including Honda Pilot and Toyota 4Runner. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Acadia and Terrain continue to vie for GMC&#146;s highest conquest rate. More than half of all Acadia and Terrain customers are coming from non-GM brands, which has helped GMC gain share in key
high-volume markets including California, New York and Florida. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;I&#146;ve seen more import trade-ins in the past six months than
I&#146;ve ever seen in 27 years in the business,&#148; said Christine Alicandro, dealer principal, Marty&#146;s GMC in the Boston area. &#147;We recently had a customer trade in a 2010 Mercedes S550 for an Acadia Denali, which really says something
powerful about GMC&#146;s reputation for styling and quality and Denali&#146;s appeal as a luxury brand within GMC.&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><U>Denali</U> is a
core brand for GMC, providing a unique blend of professional grade capability along with exclusive styling and premium content. Demand has more than doubled this year, with Denali models accounting for 16 percent of GMC retail sales in May and
calendar year to date, compared to 8 percent in 2010. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Interest in GMC is on the rise among consumers in general. At <U>Main Street in
Motion</U>, a touring test-drive event that pits GMC against other brands, exit polls revealed that public opinion of GMC improved by 25 percent and purchase consideration improved by 78 percent. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Retail sales of Sierra, which offers best-in-class V8 fuel economy on the Sierra XFE, increased 23 percent in May with total sales up 25 percent for the
first five months of the year. Sierra sales were led by its HD models, which were up 22 percent, year over year. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px;padding-bottom:0px;"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Sales of
<U>Yukon</U>, which recently took top honors in the full-size SUV category of AutoPacific&#146;s 15</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">th</SUP></FONT><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> annual Vehicle Satisfaction Awards, continue to grow in 2011. Yukon/XL&#146;s combined retail </FONT></P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">

<IMG SRC="g194731ex99_1pg5.jpg" ALT="LOGO"> </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">
sales are up 14 percent calendar year to date and its combined total sales &#150; retail and fleet &#150; are up 9 percent for the same period. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>About GMC </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><U>GMC</U> has built trucks
since 1902, and is one of the industry&#146;s healthiest brands. Today GMC is evolving to offer more fuel-efficient trucks and crossovers, including the <U>Terrain small SUV</U> and <U>Acadia crossover</U>. The new GMC <U>Sierra Heavy Duty
pickups</U> are the most capable and powerful trucks in the market. Innovation and engineering excellence are woven into all GMCs, including the <U>Yukon and Yukon XL SUVs</U> and full line of <U>Sierra pickups</U>. Today, GMC is the only
manufacturer offering three full-size hybrid trucks. Details on all GMC models are available at <U>www.gmc.com</U>, on Twitter at @thisisgmc or at <U>www.facebook.com/gmc</U>. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT

<TD VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">For Release Wednesday, June&nbsp;1, 2011, 10:45 a.m. EDT</FONT></P>
<P STYLE="font-size:24px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Cadillac U.S. Retail Sales Rise 8 Percent in May</B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="font-size:12px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" align="left">&nbsp;</P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4.00em; text-indent:-1.50em"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>&#149;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;16<FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP
STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">th</SUP></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> consecutive month of year-over-year retail sales gains</FONT></B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4.00em; text-indent:-1.50em"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>&#149;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;CTS
continues strong year-to-year retail growth, up 28 percent</B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4.00em; text-indent:-1.50em"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>&#149;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Escalade retail sales up 10 percent</B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>DETROIT &#150;</B> Cadillac continued its 16-month run of year-to-year sales gains, reporting U.S. retail sales increased 8 percent in May to 9,832, led by the CTS family of luxury cars and Escalade
line of luxury SUVs.</FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;Cadillac remains a strong, successful brand
that is approaching a year-and-a-half run of consecutive retail sales gains,&#148; said Kurt McNeil, vice president of Cadillac Sales and Service. &#147;It&#146;s a testament to our solid product offerings among the CTS, SRX and Escalade brands and
our attention to superior customer service.&#148;</FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The <U>CTS Sedan</U>,
<U>Wagon</U> and <U>Coupe</U> posted retail sales of 3,686 units in May for a 28 percent increase compared to the same month last year and year-to-date retail sales of the CTS family are up 75 percent. The CTS family includes the high-performance
V-Series models, which this year is competing against top luxury sports cars in the SCCA World Challenge GT racing series.</FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><U>SRX</U> retail sales also remained strong in May at 3,617 units. SRX has a calendar year-to-date retail sales increase of 22 percent. Since being redesigned for the 2010 model year, the SRX has
continued to gain market share and receive high marks from automotive journalists and industry analysts.</FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Retail sales of the Cadillac Escalade also grew in May to 1,706 units, a 10-percent gain over last year and a 10 percent calendar-year-to-date increase. Escalade remains the top selling luxury SUV brand
in the United States.</FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:18px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>About Cadillac</B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Cadillac has been a leading luxury auto brand since 1902. In recent years, Cadillac
has engineered a historic renaissance led by artful engineering and advanced technology. More information on Cadillac can be found at <U>media.cadillac.com</U>.</FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
